title: Claude-named tool shim symlink install (non-wkwrap tools)
desc: How to manually install Claude-named .cmd shims into WKAppBot/bin/ when wkwrap --install does not cover them.
steps: CONTEXT: wkwrap --install only handles wk*.ps1 files. Claude-named shims live in personal-docs/tools/ and need manual mklink into WKAppBot/bin/.
SOURCE: D:/GitHub/personal-docs/tools/ owns .cmd and .ps1 for 10 shims: Edit Write Read Glob Grep Agent Bash Cmd PS(owerShell) wkharness.
INSTALL: run elevated cmd -- mklink D:/GitHub/WKAppBot/bin/TOOL.cmd D:/GitHub/personal-docs/tools/TOOL.cmd
Where Name -match shim -- check LinkType=SymbolicLink and Target to personal-docs.
STATUS (2026-05-24): all 10 symlinks confirmed OK. wkharness.cmd was the last missing one, added this session.
